seo_description: An orthopaedic dog bed with a solid foam rim to rest a chin on, not a stuffed one. Grey, Medium 94 x 72cm and Large 112 x 85cm. 100-night trial.
feed_title: Orthopaedic Dog Bed with Raised Foam Edge, Medium 94 x 72cm and Large 112 x 85cm, Washable Cover, Grey | PawLunova Langdale
descriptionHtml:
94 and 112cm. A rim cut from foam. Built round one habit.

Langdale is an orthopaedic foam dog bed with a raised foam edge, in Medium 94 × 72cm and Large 112 × 85cm. The cover machine washes.

A bolster gets sold as a wall. Most dogs use it as a pillow. Look where the head goes: the sofa arm, the bottom stair, your foot. Never the flat middle of the floor. A heavy head wants something solid; most beds offer a fabric tube.

This rim is cut from foam, not stuffed, so it holds a defined edge under a resting head.

What they get

  • A rim built from foam: A resting edge for a heavy head, not a fabric tube.
  • A foam base beneath them: Cushioning under the whole sleeping area, framed by the rim.
  • A cover that machine washes: It comes off and goes in, per its care label.
  • Quietly good-looking: An understated grey for a living room.

Best for: Habitual head-resters and big dogs who need floor. At 112 × 85cm the Large is the widest bed here, and the one bought for its rim.

Why it is worth the money

£79 for the Medium, £99 for the Large. Most of what you pay for is what you never see. Loose filling is cheap and shifts under a head until there is nothing left to lean on. Foam keeps its line, in the base and in the rim. If a written 5-year foam guarantee is what you want, our Coniston and Borrowdale carry one.

You still have 100 nights to check. If they do not settle into it, we collect free from the UK mainland and refund every penny.

Two honest notes. A foam rim is firmer than a stuffed one, so a dog who flops over it feels that edge. And we publish 18cm of depth for the Medium only. No verified figure exists for the Large, so we print none.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)Colour
Medium94 × 72 × 18Grey
Large112 × 85Grey

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. The raised edge sits inside these figures, so size up between sizes. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Take the cover off and wash it to the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. Any guarantee we give is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

Medium or Large?

Side-on length plus 15 to 20cm, then size up.

Is delivery free?

Over £40 it is, and both sizes clear that.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Payment choices appear at checkout.

How firm is the raised edge?

Foam, not filling. It holds shape instead of collapsing.

Is this sensible for a dog getting on in years?

We can only describe it. Foam base, foam rim, 18cm on the Medium. Resting surfaces are your vet's call.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes, the cover comes off and machine washes.

What if they ignore it?

Return it inside 100 nights and we pay collection.

facts_used: Langdale is an orthopaedic foam dog bed with a raised, structured edge, in Medium (94 × 72cm) and Large (112 × 85cm). The rim is made from foam rather than loose filling, so it holds a defined edge where a stuffed border would sag.
**A rim built from foam:** A proper resting edge for a heavy head, not a floppy fabric tube.
**A foam base beneath them:** Cushioning under the whole sleeping area, framed by the raised surround.
**A machine-washable cover:** It comes off and washes according to its care label.
**Quietly good-looking:** An understated grey that sits in a living room without shouting about it.
Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the raised edge takes up some of that, so between sizes, size up.
Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
Best for: Habitual head-resters and dogs who like to sleep pressed against an edge.
differentiation_note: The only bed here whose rim is cut from foam rather than stuffed, and the widest footprint in the batch at 112 × 85cm for £99 — bought for the edge itself. It carries no waterproof liner and no foam guarantee, and the page says so by pointing head-resters who want those to Coniston and Borrowdale.
